parameters.content:
## Poll KSeF for new received invoices and download the PDFs

### How it works
KSeF has no email or webhook notifications, so this workflow polls your self-hosted [KSeF Gateway](https://github.com/jurczykpawel/ksef-gateway) every 20 minutes for invoices issued to you, using its stateless `/ksef/invoices/received/new` cursor. The checkpoint (`nextSince`) lives in this workflow's own static data (scope `global`), so the gateway itself doesn't need a database. The checkpoint only moves forward after every PDF of the batch was downloaded, saved and emailed; if a run fails midway the whole window is retried (at-least-once: a notification may repeat, an invoice is never skipped). The **Send Email** node sends one SMTP email per invoice with the PDF attached.

### Setup
1. Deploy a KSeF Gateway instance with a certificate that has the `InvoiceRead` permission (KSeF tokens are being phased out - certificates are the durable path). New to KSeF, or need a certificate? See [the main README](https://github.com/jurczykpawel/ksef-gateway#certificate-based-auth-alternative-to-tokens).
2. Open **Configuration (EDIT ME)** and fill in your gateway URL, NIP, the folder where PDFs should be saved and - on Render's free tier - the PDF service URL. Then pick a **Header Auth** credential (name `X-Api-Key`, value = your `GATEWAY_API_KEY`) on the three HTTP Request nodes.
3. Replace `notifyEmailFrom` and `notifyEmailTo` (`faktury@example.com` placeholders) in **Configuration (EDIT ME)** with real addresses. Select an **SMTP** credential on **Send Email**; never put SMTP passwords in the workflow JSON. Mail failures stop the run before the checkpoint is committed; retries can repeat emails.
4. **Activate** the workflow. Static data is only saved in production runs, so a manual test run does not move the checkpoint. The first run looks back 30 days; later runs only fetch what's new.

### Customization tips
KSeF caps this endpoint at 20 requests/hour - don't schedule more often than every 15 minutes. Swap **Save PDF To Disk** for a Google Drive, S3, or Dropbox node if you'd rather store invoices there. Set an **Error Workflow** in the workflow settings to get alerted when the gateway keeps failing.

nodes.name: Poll Every 20 Minutes
nodes.notes: KSeF caps query/metadata at 20 req/h - don't go below ~15 min per the gateway's own rate limiter.

nodes.name: Configuration (EDIT ME)
nodes.notes: ksefNip must have a certificate with the InvoiceRead permission. ksefInvoicesDir must exist, be writable by n8n AND lie inside n8n's allowed file path (default ~/.n8n-files, see N8N_RESTRICT_FILE_ACCESS_TO) - otherwise 'Save PDF To Disk' fails with 'Access to the file is not allowed'. pdfServiceUrl: only for Render's free tier (public URL of the PDF service, e.g. https://xxx.onrender.com) - leave empty elsewhere. The gateway API key is NOT stored here - pick a Header Auth credential on the HTTP Request nodes. Replace notifyEmailFrom and notifyEmailTo placeholders with real addresses and select an SMTP credential on Send Email; SMTP secrets are not stored here.

nodes.name: Wake Gateway
nodes.notes: GET /health needs no API key. neverError so a 503 / error page during cold start is just 'not ready yet'.

nodes.name: Wake PDF Service
nodes.notes: With pdfServiceUrl empty this just calls the gateway /health again (harmless).

nodes.name: Gateway Ready?
nodes.notes: Passes when both services answer {status: ok}, or after 8 tries (then the poll below decides).

nodes.name: Get Checkpoint
nodes.notes: First run: since=null -> gateway defaults to last 30 days. Later runs: since=last committed nextSince. Scope is 'global' on purpose: 'node' static data is private to the node that wrote it, so Get Checkpoint would never see what Remember Checkpoint stored.

nodes.name: Get New Invoices
nodes.notes: neverError: true so 429/502/503 come through as normal JSON ({success:false,...}) instead of throwing - handled by the Success? branch below. Retries cover plain timeouts.

nodes.name: Count Poll Failure
nodes.notes: Checkpoint is untouched here - the next scheduled run retries the same window. Throws after 6 failures in a row so an Error Workflow (workflow settings) can alert you.

nodes.name: Remember Checkpoint
nodes.notes: Output: {invoices, hasMore, nextSince}. The new checkpoint is only remembered (pending) here; it is committed after the PDFs are saved (or immediately when there is nothing to send).

nodes.name: No New Invoices
nodes.notes: Nothing new: commit the remembered checkpoint and finish.

nodes.name: Split Invoices
nodes.notes: Each output item = one ReceivedInvoiceSummary: ksefNumber, invoiceNumber, sellerNip, sellerName, netAmount, grossAmount, vatAmount, currency, issueDate, hasAttachment.

nodes.name: Download Invoice PDF
nodes.notes: Same endpoint works for invoices you sent or received - no separate PDF endpoint for the buyer role. One request at a time (the gateway allows 16 invoices/get per minute); retries survive a PDF service cold start.

nodes.name: Save PDF To Disk
nodes.notes: Writes to disk on the machine running n8n. Swap for a Google Drive / S3 / Dropbox node if you'd rather store invoices there.

parameters.subject: ={{ 'KSeF ' + $('Split Invoices').item.json.ksefNumber + ' | ' + ($('Split Invoices').item.json.sellerName || $('Split Invoices').item.json.sellerNip) + ' | ' + $('Split Invoices').item.json.grossAmount + ' ' + $('Split Invoices').item.json.currency }}
parameters.text:
={{ 'KSeF: ' + $('Split Invoices').item.json.ksefNumber + '
Seller: ' + ($('Split Invoices').item.json.sellerName || $('Split Invoices').item.json.sellerNip) + '
Seller NIP: ' + $('Split Invoices').item.json.sellerNip + '
Issue date: ' + $('Split Invoices').item.json.issueDate.slice(0, 10) + '
Gross: ' + $('Split Invoices').item.json.grossAmount + ' ' + $('Split Invoices').item.json.currency }}

nodes.name: Send Email
nodes.notes: Select an SMTP credential and replace notifyEmailFrom/notifyEmailTo in Configuration (EDIT ME). Sends one email per invoice with binary data as its PDF attachment. A send failure stops the run before Commit Checkpoint; retrying the window can repeat already sent emails.

nodes.name: Commit Checkpoint
nodes.notes: Runs once the whole batch is saved and notified and commits the checkpoint. If anything above failed, this is skipped and the next run retries the same window.

parameters.content:
## 1 · Trigger & config
Runs on a schedule and holds every setting you edit in one place - gateway URL, seller NIP, optional PDF service URL and the folder to save PDFs into. Start here.

## 2 · Wake the services
Render's free tier puts services to sleep after ~15 minutes, and the first request then gets an error page for up to a minute. This loop calls `/health` (gateway and PDF service) and retries every 30 s, up to 8 times, before polling. On an always-on host it passes straight through.

## 3 · Poll since checkpoint
Reads the stored high-water mark, then asks the KSeF Gateway for every invoice received after it. A stateless polling cursor - no database or extra storage needed.

## 4 · Handle poll errors
If the gateway call fails, count it and stop. The checkpoint is untouched, so the next scheduled run retries the same window. After 6 failures in a row (~2 h) the run fails on purpose, so an Error Workflow can alert you.

## 5 · Remember & gate
Remember the new checkpoint (it is only committed after delivery), then branch: commit and exit when nothing new arrived, or continue when there are fresh invoices.

## 6 · Download, save & commit
Split the batch, download each PDF (one at a time - the gateway rate-limits `invoices/get`), save it, notify, and only then commit the checkpoint.
